title: DANZABOSS plan
description: Authoritative internal execution plan. New product-linked atomic leaves use ids such as 71-A; legacy dotted task trees remain readable.

spec_ref.description: path/hash of the spec this plan derives from

order.description: leaf ids in validated execution order (written by the workstation planner)

id.description: product-linked atomic id (71-A) or legacy dotted id

description.description: ONE concern; conjunction chains are rejected by the validator

feature_id.description: approved numeric product feature id; required for atomic ids

size_est.description: estimated minutes; legacy dotted plans allow up to 30

depends_on.description: task ids that must complete first (leaves only)

writes.description: non-empty files/areas touched; kept for wave planning

flags.description: hard-stop markers surfaced at planning time (Rules 13-15)
